description:
Many buyers think foreclosures are glitz, glam, and a steal of a deal. But the reality is often very different.

Once you start adding repair costs, hidden issues, and other expenses, the real good, bad, and ugly of foreclosures starts to show.

One important thing to understand: foreclosures are not a zero-down situation.
You need to have money ready because buying one can come with unexpected costs.

A knowledgeable Central Texas Realtor can help you understand the risks and opportunities before jumping into a foreclosure purchase.
